title: Nonnegativity of a product of squares
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $d$ and $e$ be any real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The uniform expectation of $d(x)^2e(x)^2$ is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: $d,e$ are any real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
